* **Price:** $129.00 on both

* **Availability / Shipping:** In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days on both
* **Returns:** 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method on both
* **Warranty:** 1-year limited warranty on both
* **Specs / In the box:** over-ear, closed back, ANC with transparency mode, up to 40 hours with ANC on, USB-C fast charge, Bluetooth 5.3 with two-device pairing, 254g, headphones + carry case + USB-C cable + 3.5mm cable on both

So I can't recommend one over the other on price, shipping speed, returns, warranty, or ratings — they're identical in the information provided.
